description: Public calculator (NO token needed): audit a weekly lifting split across all 17 muscle groups using fractional set accounting (1.0x primary mover, 0.5x secondary synergist, RPE >= 6 hard-set filter) against Schoenfeld & Pelland MEV / MAV / MRV landmarks.

entries.description: Weekly movement entries mapped to curated biomechanics archetypes.

frequency_days.description: Days per week this movement is trained.

rpe.description: Average set RPE (sets < RPE 6.0 are filtered out as warm-ups).

sets.description: Total weekly sets for this movement.

name: volume_audit
